configurations.name: static-preview
runtimeArgs: import os, http.server, socketserver; port = int(os.environ.get('PORT', '4173')); socketserver.TCPServer.allow_reuse_address = True; httpd = socketserver.TCPServer(('', port), http.server.SimpleHTTPRequestHandler); print('serving on port %d' % port, flush=True); httpd.serve_forever()
